rv.q: No wonder then that The Feel Good Story America Needs Right Now turns out to be precisely what the laugh doctor ordered.
The Feel Good Story America Needs Right Now, set in a suite in The Four Seasons hotel in New York City, is strongly recommended.

cn.t: Critics praise this world premiere comedy for its wild, chaotic energy as six former hostages reunite for a TV interview about their escape from Sudanese terrorists, delivering the comedic mayhem audiences crave.
